title: MemForce question set
description: A batch of quiz questions that can be imported into MemForce. See docs/question-import-format.md for the full specification.

formatVersion.description: Version of this question-set format. Bump only when the structure below changes incompatibly.

name.description: Short human-readable label for the set, e.g. for a file listing. Not imported as data.

description.description: Optional free-text summary of what the set covers. Not imported as data.

tags.description: Tags inherited by every question in this set (e.g. the subject area). Merged with each question's own tags at import time.

questions.description: The questions to import. Must contain at least one entry.

tagName.description: A tag name. Matching against existing tags is case-insensitive, so prefer lower-case kebab-case (e.g. "world-history") for readability and to avoid accidental near-duplicates.

question.description: The question text. Maps to the question's name in MemForce.

answer.description: The answer text. Optional; MemForce allows questions without a stored answer.

tags.description: Tags that apply only to this question, in addition to the set-level tags.
